card.name: Word just before a ≥ or ≤ sign
card.fires_on: The word right before a greater-than-or-equal or less-than-or-equal sign, most often "Grade" in toxicity thresholds like "Grade ≥3" or "recovery to Grade ≤ 1". Also "were", "Patients" or "DBP" before an age or value cutoff.

modes.label: Grade before a cutoff
modes.description: The word Grade just before ≥ or ≤ and a severity number in dose-hold or adverse-event text.
modes.example: Withhold IBTROZI until recovery to<< Grade>> ≤1 or baseline.

modes.label: Age or measurement cutoff
modes.description: A word such as were, Patients or DBP that comes right before ≥ and an age or blood pressure value.

card.writes: It seems to steer the model away from symbols like × § → and toward variable-like names, so the next symbol is a comparison sign.
card.plain: It lights up on the word that comes just before a ≥ or ≤ sign, usually "Grade" in toxicity thresholds.
